ns2:course.label: Nutrition Assessment & Therapy
ns2:course.description: Problem-based learning application (via cases) of the nutrition care process with emphasis on nutrition assessment, diagnosis, intervention, monitoring and evaluation, as related to the management and treatment of disease states. This course is the clinical capstone course for the dietetics curriculum. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FSHN 420, or concurrent enrollment required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FSHN 420, or concurrent enrollment required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Senior or Junior class standing. Restricted to BS:F Sci&Hm Nutr-Diettcs -UIUC or BS:F Sc&Hum Nutrition-HN -UIUC.
